description: Crowd-sourced 'Sealed Indictments' tracking table covering 10/30/17 through 7/31/18, credited to a pseudonymous research team of Twitter handles. It lists every U.S. federal district court by state/district with monthly counts of new sealed court proceedings, a totals row, and a highlighted grand total of 45,468 filings (5,052 per month average), citing PACER.gov as source. Footnotes note a claimed 2006 baseline of 1,077 per year and state the numbers include criminal charges and search warrants, some since unsealed or removed. The table body of roughly 94 districts x 6 monthly columns is summarized rather than transcribed cell-by-cell.
text: Sealed Indictments: 10/30/17 through 7/31/18. From the Research Team of: @Arazel50, @Avery1776, @Avonsalez, @damartin32, @emarie1225, @KathyMicale, @MScipio_African &, @Tspinnerchaser and @vstil. State, District. Abbrev. 10/30/17 - 2/28/18. 3/1-3/31. 4/1-4/30. 5/1-5/31. 6/1-6/30. 7/1-7/31. [Table of ~94 federal districts from Alaska (AK) through Wyoming (WY), incl. Guam, Puerto Rico, Virgin Islands, Northern Mariana Islands; Georgia, Northern row reads 'No Data Available'; largest entries include California, Central 1525 and Texas, Western 811 in the first period]. Totals. 18,510. 6,034. 5,326. 5,318. 5,295. 4,985. Total filed from 10/30/17 to 7/31/18 = 45,468 (5,052 per month average). * Back-up files at: https://tinyurl.com/yd5vn9ou. * Source: PACER.gov. * How many are normal? 1,077 in all of 2006 per 2009 report: https://tinyurl.com/y97q9w4g. * The numbers represent new sealed court proceedings filed in U.S. Federal District Criminal Courts during the periods listed and include criminal charges and search warrants. Some of them have since been unsealed or removed. * Additional contributions by: @buildthewall_20, @LemboPhil, @t193931 and @TanHaley
flags: The 'sealed indictments' methodology conflates all sealed court proceedings (incl. search warrants and routine matters) with indictments; counts are the compilers' claim and widely disputed
Compiled by pseudonymous social-media accounts, not an official source
FLAGGED FOR MANUAL REVIEW: full per-district table (~94 rows x 6 monthly columns of numbers) not transcribed cell-by-cell; headers, totals and footnotes captured

description: Screenshot of a verified Eric Trump tweet, captured 4 minutes after posting, accusing the Washington Post of ugly, unrelenting hatred toward his family and company and asserting it comes 'from the top,' tagging @JeffBezos. Engagement counts show 113 replies, 190 retweets, 440 likes.
text: Eric Trump @EricTrump · 4m. The level of hatred and the willingness to disparage my family and our great company has never been so ugly and unrelenting as I have seen recently by the @WashingtonPost. It is clearly coming from the top with one motivation in mind. @JeffBezos. 113. 190. 440.
flags: The tweet's characterization of Washington Post coverage and Bezos's motivation is Eric Trump's claim
